reviews.title: Great value
reviews.comment: I don’t know if it could be better at the price point. Sounds good, mic quality is good (I think, no one’s complained in my party chats), comfortable to wear. The mic isn’t super easy to put back into the headset because of the cord flexibility, which is nice most of the time.
reviews.author: Isaiah Comer

reviews.title: Very comfortable and appear well made.  I have used for long gaming sessions without problem.
reviews.comment: I am tired of fighting cordless.  These are very light, have very comfortable foam, and appear well made.  I think they are a good buy for the price.
reviews.author: S. Tucker

reviews.title: Complete garbage
reviews.comment: Would only work as headphones. Mic never picked up. Spent like 2 hours trying to get it working. Do NOT buy this headset.
reviews.author: Scott Thompson

reviews.title: Audífonos de segunda
reviews.comment: Buen precio pero el micrófono a la hora de guardarlo otra vez se estanca y se hace difícil de guardarlo
reviews.author: juan

reviews.title: Headphone nice
reviews.comment: Best quality, sound is nice. Highly recommend this headset to everyone. I have it for 6 months now and it’s working great. No strips, no broken parts it’s the best.
